verdict.rationale: The Referrals API automates uploading whole lists of referrals and referral details to block and trust lists (adyen-risk-docs-13, adyen-risk-docs-7), which is bulk operation on one item type. The documented case-management flow has a reviewer accept or reject individual transactions, with no batch action shown (adyen-risk-docs-9). Missing for 10: bulk actions beyond risk-list uploads (e.g., batch case review or batch rule/profile edits), documented batch limits or semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
